label: Common esse ancestry and composition give strict actual effect coverage
paraphrase: Closed conditional test of actual esse-effect coverage. For any same q3 Profile, existing common esse ancestry plus actual cause composition supplies one actual n with represented esse-essence identity whose actual distinct esse effects strictly include those of every other actual bearer. The source's no-incoming-actual-cause clause excludes n from others' effects; n itself causes each other bearer. This establishes actual esse-causal coverage; a productive reading still requires the retained mode/application bridge. It establishes no more-esse comparison, capacity, necessity, present conservation, divine identity or metaphysical possibility of a natural rival.
